description: Page views, link clicks (with click-through rate per link), QR code scans and top countries, for the last N days, a from–to range, or all time (stats are kept for the page's whole life). Pass link (a block id from get_my_page) for one link's clicks per day and countries.

allTime.description: Everything since the page's first visit.

days.description: The last N days, today included. Default 30.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Use with to.

link.description: A block id, for that link's own numbers.

name: get_stats
title: Get analytics
